descripcion: Ejemplos few-shot elaborados para LLM-B v2. Cada uno pareja: JSON del clasificador reconstruido + nota clínica elaborada con morfología + citación de shapelet + reporte de confidence gap. Redactados en inglés para experimento LLM-B v2 (comparación con PTB-XL). Distribución: 3 por clase (alto/moderado/bajo confidence gap) para enseñar los 3 escenarios.

ejemplos.nota_clinica: Lead II shows a single beat with narrow QRS complex of normal morphology and a monophasic positive P wave preceding the QRS. PR interval is within physiological range. The shapelet Micro_S3 (MSM distance = 1.65) provides the principal geometric evidence supporting the NORMAL classification. Confidence gap = 0.90 indicates high classifier certainty.

Lead II presents a beat with normal-appearing QRS morphology and a P wave preceding the ventricular complex. The shapelet Micro_S52 (MSM distance = 2.42) is the closest geometric match, supporting classification as NORMAL. Confidence gap = 0.56 indicates moderate certainty; visual confirmation of P wave morphology is suggested.

Lead II shows a beat with QRS morphology consistent with normal conduction, though the P wave morphology approaches the PAC discrimination boundary. The shapelet Micro_S59 (MSM distance = 2.10) is the principal evidence, but competing morphological patterns are noted. Confidence gap = 0.20 (< 0.25) indicates low classifier certainty. Immediate cardiologist review is recommended.

Lead II shows a premature beat interrupting the sinus rhythm, characterized by an ectopic P wave of altered morphology preceding a narrow QRS complex. The shapelet Micro_S59 (MSM distance = 1.28) is the discriminative pattern for premature atrial contractions. Confidence gap = 0.76 indicates high classifier certainty.

Lead II presents a premature atrial contraction with characteristics compatible with a bigeminy pattern. The premature P wave morphology differs from the sinus P waves. The shapelet Micro_S52 (MSM distance = 1.55) supports PAC classification. Confidence gap = 0.44 indicates moderate certainty; visual confirmation of the ectopic P wave morphology is suggested.

Lead II shows a beat with premature timing, though morphological features between premature atrial contraction and aberrant normal beat overlap. The shapelet Micro_S3 (MSM distance = 1.85) provides the closest geometric match. Confidence gap = 0.16 (< 0.25) indicates low classifier certainty. Immediate cardiologist review is recommended.

Lead II shows a regular rhythm with monophasic P waves preceding each QRS complex in a 1:1 atrioventricular relationship. R-R intervals are regular with physiological variability under 10%. The shapelet Macro_S54 (MSM distance = 1.15) provides the principal evidence for normal sinus rhythm. Confidence gap = 0.88 indicates high classifier certainty.

Lead II presents a rhythm with discernible P waves preceding QRS complexes and moderately regular R-R intervals. The shapelet Macro_S56 (MSM distance = 1.85) supports normal sinus rhythm classification. Confidence gap = 0.50 indicates moderate certainty; visual confirmation of P wave regularity is suggested.

Lead II shows a rhythm compatible with sinus origin, though R-R interval variability approaches the AFIB discrimination boundary. The shapelet Macro_S22 (MSM distance = 2.05) is the closest geometric match. Confidence gap = 0.16 (< 0.25) indicates low classifier certainty. Immediate cardiologist review is recommended to rule out atrial fibrillation with regular ventricular response.

Lead II shows absent P waves replaced by irregular baseline fibrillatory undulations, with irregularly irregular R-R intervals characteristic of atrial fibrillation with rapid ventricular response. QRS complexes retain narrow morphology consistent with normal ventricular conduction. The shapelet Macro_S54 (MSM distance = 1.31) provides the principal evidence for AFIB. Confidence gap = 0.82 indicates high classifier certainty.

Lead II presents irregularly irregular R-R intervals with absent discernible P waves, consistent with atrial fibrillation with controlled ventricular response. Fibrillatory undulations are visible in the baseline. The shapelet Macro_S56 (MSM distance = 1.72) supports AFIB classification. Confidence gap = 0.58 indicates high classifier certainty.

Lead II shows R-R interval irregularity and reduced P wave amplitude, though baseline fibrillatory activity is subtle. Morphological features overlap between atrial fibrillation and sinus rhythm with variable P waves. The shapelet Macro_S22 (MSM distance = 1.90) is the closest geometric match. Confidence gap = 0.10 (< 0.25) indicates low classifier certainty. Immediate cardiologist review is recommended to distinguish AFIB from sinus rhythm with atrial ectopy.
